annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "letter" on page 615 ("The Ricorso — Dawn"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within dawn breaking over Dublin Bay, St. Kevin bathing at Glendalough, St. Patrick vs. the Archdruid Balkelly, ALP's dissolving final monologue into the sea. During this Ricorso (The Return) phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
